6 slots, each with its own page and JSON declaration. See [how this reference is built](/reference/slots/).

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| [`cache.clear`](/reference/slots/cache/cache.clear/) | Clears cached items matching the optional filter. |
| [`cache.count`](/reference/slots/cache/cache.count/) | Counts cached items matching the optional filter. |
| [`cache.get`](/reference/slots/cache/cache.get/) | Returns a cached value by key. |
| [`cache.list`](/reference/slots/cache/cache.list/) | Lists cached keys matching the optional filter. |
| [`cache.set`](/reference/slots/cache/cache.set/) | Stores a value in the in-memory cache under a key, with an optional sliding expiration. |
| [`cache.try-get`](/reference/slots/cache/cache.try-get/) | Returns a cached value by key if it exists, or creates a new cached item and returning it. |
